description: Use for one named area of the market ("how is on-chain?", "what is liquidity saying?"), as its Analysis page shows it today: the read, how confident it is and when it last changed, the read by horizon (days, weeks, months), the reasoning in plain English (what holds it up, what could change it) and the state of each of its parts. Areas: technical, on-chain, market-structure, sentiment and macro (the five areas of the read), and cross-market (how the five line up), liquidity (the price levels where forced buying and selling sit, funding and the next big options expiry) and cycle (where Bitcoin is in its four-year cycle). For every area at once with the price and the forces use get_bitcoin_today; for the parts of all five areas side by side get_market_detail. Free.

area.description: The area, as named on btcintel.org/analysis/.
